description: TypeScript (vitest): three ACs, only the hours path is tested; the minutes path and the invalid-input RangeError are untested.
pr_body:
Add parseDuration, which converts strings like "1h30m" to seconds.

## Acceptance criteria
- Hours and minutes combine, so "1h30m" is 5400 seconds.
- Minutes alone work, so "45m" is 2700 seconds.
- An invalid string throws a RangeError.

acceptable.reason: Combining hours and minutes is never exercised: the only test uses hours alone.
Empty input (the !input guard) is untested; the regex alone accepts it.

expected.notes: missing_test x2 (minutes path, invalid-input throw). The hours+minutes combination is also untested, so it is acceptable on the return line.
